Name: Trip's 420 Sebastian
Author: TripTripSix
Description:
Yeah, you heard me right. This is a mod that literally just makes Sebastian high all the time. I may be insane, but I am free.

This is my first time modding anything and I wanted to test the waters with something my friend came up with on impulse. We found it really funny, so figured I'd use it as an excuse to learn stuff.

In future updates I plan to add some blazed dialogue for him too, but I'll figure that out another time.

His sprites, portraits, and beach equivalents are changed.

Have fun!

Downloads.Description: Fixed a minor error in the config file :)
